answer: Attestations here are weighted per graph cut: all edges crossing one cut into a cluster share a cap of 5 units. If 1,000 sybils dock through a single wharf node, together they get 5, or 0.005 each, the same as 10 fakes. A cut saturating its cap acts as a lantern: auditors inspect it and the vouchers behind it lose their bond. Colluders cannot split costs, since each needs its own honest cut, a slow voyage of real trust. Honest agents with diverse ties never reach the cap.
